Trade Coverage

2017-18 NHL Trade Tracker

Official deals since June 14

NHL.com @NHL

Welcome to the 2017-18 NHL Trade Tracker, the official list of completed deals since June 14. This is your one-stop shop for news, analysis and reaction from around the League as teams position themselves for the present and beyond.

 

MARCH 21: Philadelphia Flyers acquire 2019 third-round pick from Edmonton Oilers in exchange for rights to forward Cooper Marody. | Flyers trade pick to Oilers for rights to Marody

 

FEBRUARY 26: Tampa Bay Lightning acquire defenseman Ryan McDonagh, forward J.T. Miller from New York Rangers in exchange for forward Vladislav Namestnikov, defenseman Libor Hajek, forward Brett Howden, 2018 first-round pick, 2019 conditional first-round pick. | McDonagh, Miller traded to Lightning from Rangers

 

FEBRUARY 26: Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward Tomas Tatar from Detroit Red Wings in exchange for 2018 first-round pick, 2019 second-round pick, 2021 third-round pick. | Tatar traded to Golden Knights from Red Wings

 

FEBRUARY 26: San Jose Sharks acquire forward Evander Kane from Buffalo Sabres in exchange for 2019 conditional first-round pick, 2019 fourth-round pick, forward Dan O'Regan. | Kane traded to Sharks from Sabres

 

FEBRUARY 26: Columbus Blue Jackets acquire forward Thomas Vanek from Vancouver Canucks in exchange for forwards Tyler Motte, Jussi Jokinen. | Vanek traded to Blue Jackets from Canucks

 

FEBRUARY 26: New Jersey Devils acquire forward Patrick Maroon from Edmonton Oilers in exchange for 2019 third-round pick, forward Joey Dudek. | Maroon traded to Devils from Oilers

 

FEBRUARY 26: New York Rangers acquire defenseman Chris Bigras from Colorado Avalanche in exchange for defenseman Ryan Graves. | Graves traded to Avalanche from Rangers

 

FEBRUARY 26: Nashville Predators acquire forward Tyler Gaudet, defenseman John Ramage from Arizona Coyotes in exchange for defenseman Trevor Murphy, forward Pierre-Cedric Labrie. | Predators, Coyotes complete four-player trade

 

FEBRUARY 26: Boston Bruins acquire forward Tommy Wingels from Chicago Blackhawks in exchange for 2019 conditional fifth-round pick. | Wingels traded to Bruins from Blackhawks

 

FEBRUARY 26: Pittsburgh Penguins acquire forward Josh Jooris from Carolina Hurricanes in exchange for forward Greg McKegg. | Jooris traded to Penguins from Hurricanes

 

FEBRUARY 26: Calgary Flames acquire forward Nick Shore from Ottawa Senators in exchange for 2019 seventh-round pick. | Shore traded to Flames from Senators

 

FEBRUARY 26: Montreal Canadiens acquire defenseman Mike Reilly from Minnesota Wild in exchange for 2019 fifth-round pick. | Reilly to Canadiens from Wild 

 

FEBRUARY 26: Winnipeg Jets acquire defenseman Joe Morrow from Montreal Canadiens in exchange for 2018 fourth-round pick. | Morrow traded to Jets from Canadiens

 

FEBRUARY 26: Anaheim Ducks acquire forward Jason Chimera from New York Islanders in exchange for forward Chris Wagner. | Chimera traded to Ducks from Islanders

 

FEBRUARY 26: Columbus Blue Jackets acquire forward Ryan Kujawinski from Arizona Coyotes in exchange for forward Jordan Maletta. | Kujawinski traded to Blue Jackets from Coyotes

 

FEBRUARY 26: Vancouver Canucks acquire forward Brendan Leipsic from Vegas Golden Knights in exchange for defenseman Philip Holm. | Leipsic traded to Canucks from Golden Knights

 

FEBRUARY 26: Winnipeg Jets acquire forward Paul Stastny from St. Louis Blues in exchange for 2018 first-round pick, rights to forward Erik Foley. | Stastny traded to Jets from Blues

 

FEBRUARY 26: Nashville Predators acquire forward Ryan Hartman, 2018 fifth-round pick from Chicago Blackhawks in exchange for forward Victor Ejdsell, 2018 first-round pick, 2018 fourth-round pick. | Hartman traded to Predators from Blackhawks

 

FEBRUARY 26: Columbus Blue Jackets acquire defenseman Ian Cole from the Ottawa Senators in exchange for forward Nick Moutrey and a third-round pick in the 2020 NHL Draft. | Cole traded to Blue Jackets by Senators

 

FEBRUARY 25: Nashville Predators acquire forward Brandon Bollig and goaltender Troy Grosenick from the San Jose Sharks in exchange for a sixth-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft. | Predators acquire Bollig, Grosenick from Sharks

 

FEBRUARY 25: Columbus Blue Jackets acquire Mark Letestu from Nashville Predators in exchange for a fourth-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft. Letestu had earlier been traded to Predators by Edmonton Oilers for Pontus Aberg | Letestu traded to Blue Jackets after being sent to Predators by Oilers

 

FEBRUARY 25: Toronto Maple Leafs acquire Tomas Plekanec and Kyle Baun from Montreal Canadiens in exchange for forward Kerby Rychel, defenseman Rinat Valiev and a second-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft | Plekanec traded to Maple Leafs by Canadiens

 

FEBRUARY 25: Boston Bruins acquire forward Rick Nash from New York Rangers in exchange for forwards Ryan Spooner and Matt Beleskey, defenseman Ryan Lindgren, Boston's first-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft and its seventh-round pick in 2018 | Nash traded to Bruins by Rangers

 

FEBRUARY 24: New York Islanders acquire defenseman Brandon Davidson from Edmonton Oilers in exchange for 2019 third-round pick. | Davidson traded to Islanders by Oilers

 

FEBRUARY 23: Pittsburgh Penguins acquire forwards Derick Brassard, Vincent Dunn, Tobias Lindberg, 2018 third-round pick (OTT); Ottawa Senators acquire defenseman Ian Cole, goalie Filip Gustavsson, 2018 first-round pick, and 2019 third-round pick (PIT); Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward Ryan Reaves and 2018 fourth-round pick (PIT from VAN). | Brassard to Penguins in three-team deal

 

FEBRUARY 22: New Jersey Devils acquire forward Michael Grabner from the New York Rangers for defenseman prospect Yegor Rykov and a second-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft. | Grabner traded to Devils by Rangers

 

FEBRUARY 22: Florida Panthers aqcuire forward Frank Vatrano from Boston Bruins for third-round pick in 2018 NHL Draft. | Vatrano traded to Panthers by Bruins

 

FEBRUARY 21: Los Angeles Kings acquire forward Tobias Rieder and goaltender Scott Wedgewood from Arizona Coyotes for goaltender Darcy Kuemper. | Rieder, Wedgewood traded to Kings by Coyotes for Kuemper

 

FEBRUARY 21: Washington Capitals acquire defenseman Jakub Jerabek from Montreal Canadiens for fifth-round pick in the 2019 NHL Draft. | Jerabek traded to Capitals by Canadiens

 

FEBRUARY 20: San Jose Sharks acquire forward Eric Fehr from Toronto Maple Leafs for seventh-round pick in the 2020 NHL Draft. | Sharks acquire Fehr from Maple Leafs 

 

FEBRUARY 20: Boston Bruins acquire defenseman Nick Holden from New York Rangers for defenseman Rob O'Gara and third-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft. | Holden traded to Bruins by Rangers

 

FEBRUARY 19: Philadelphia Flyers acquire goaltender Petr Mrazek from Detroit Red Wings for a conditional fourth-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft and a conditional third-round pick in the 2019 NHL Draft. | Mrazek traded to Flyers by Red Wings

 

FEBRUARY 19: Washington Capitals acquire defenseman Michal Kempny from Chicago Blackhawks in exchange for third-round pick in 2018 NHL Draft. | Kempny traded to Capitals by Blackhawks

 

FEBRUARY 15: St. Louis Blues acquire forward Nikita Soshnikov from Toronto Maple Leafs in exchange for fourth-round pick in 2019 NHL Draft. | Blues acquire Soshnikov from Maple Leafs

 

FEBRUARY 15: Chicago Blackhawks acquire forward Chris DiDomenico from Ottawa Senators in exchange for defenseman Ville Pokka. | Blackhawks acquire DiDomenico from Ottawa

 

FEBRUARY 13: Los Angeles Kings acquire defenseman Dion Phaneuf and forward Nate Thompson from Ottawa Senators in exchange for forwards Marian Gaborik and Nick Shore. | Phaneuf traded to Kings by Senators for Gaborik, Shore

 

FEBRUARY 9:  Washington Capitals acquire forwards Adam Chapie and Joe Whitney from New York Rangers in exchange for forward John Albert and defenseman Hubert Labrie. | Capitals Acquire Adam Chapie and Joe Whitney from New York Rangers

 

FEBRUARY 8: New Jersey Devils acquire forwards Christoph Bertschy and Mario Lucia from Minnesota Wild in exchange for defenseman Viktor Loov. | Devils acquire forwards Christoph Bertschy and Mario Lucia from Wild

 

FEBRUARY 5: Los Angeles Kings acquire future considerations from Vegas Golden Knights in exchange for defenseman Zac Leslie. | LA Kings trade Zac Leslie to Vegas Golden Knights

 

FEBRUARY 3: Dallas Stars acquire defenseman Andrew O'Brien from Nashville Predators in exchange for forward Mark McNeill. | Stars acquire defenseman Andrew O'Brien from Nashville

 

JANUARY 31: Tampa Bay Lightning acquire goaltender Edward Pasquale from Edmonton Oilers in exchange for future considerations. | Lightning acquire Edward Pasquale from Oilers

 

JANUARY 22: Columbus Blue Jackets acquire goaltender Jeff Zatkoff  from Los Angeles Kings in exchange for future considerations. | Blue Jackets Acquire Goaltender Jeff Zatkoff from LA Kings

 

JANUARY 22: Arizona Coyotes acquire defenseman John Ramage from Columbus Blue Jackets in exchange for future considerations. | Coyotes Acquire Ramage from Columbus

 

JANUARY 10: Chicago Blackhawks acquire forward Anthony Duclair and defenseman Adam Clendening from the Arizona Coyotes in exchange for forward Richard Panik and defenseman Laurent Dauphin. | Duclair traded to Blackhawks by Coyotes for Panik

 

JANUARY 4: Edmonton Oilers acquire goaltender Al Montoya from Montreal Canadiens for fourth-round pick in the 2019 NHL Draft. | Montoya traded to Oilers by Canadiens

 

DECEMBER 30: New Jersey Devils acquire goaltender Eddie Lack from Calgary Flames in exchange for defenseman Dalton Prout. | Lack traded to Devils by Flames for Prout

 

DECEMBER 19: Pittsburgh Penguins acquire defenseman Jamie Oleksiak from the Dallas Stars for conditional fourth-round pick in the 2019 NHL Draft. | Oleksiak traded to Penguins by Stars

 

DECEMBER 19: Arizona Coyotes acquire forward Josh Archibald, goaltender Sean Maguire and a 2019 sixth-round pick from Pittsburgh Penguins in exchange for goaltender Michael Leighton and a 2019 fourth-round pick. | Coyotes acquire Archibald from Penguins

 

DECEMBER 19: Florida Panthers acquire forward Gregory Chase from the Edmonton Oilers in exchange for future considerations.

 

DECEMBER 14: New Jersey Devils acquire forward Michael Latta from Arizona Coyotes for forward Ryan Kujawinski. | Devils acquire forward Michael Latta from Arizona

 

DECEMBER 8: Los Angeles Kings acquire defenseman Jordan Subban from Vancouver Canucks for center Nic Dowd. | Kings acquire defenseman Jordan Subban from Canucks

 

DECEMBER 4: Buffalo Sabres acquire forward Scott Wilson from Detroit Red Wings for 5th-round pick in 2019 Draft. | Wilson traded to Sabres by Red Wings

 

NOVEMBER 30: New Jersey Devils acquire defenseman Sami Vatanen, conditional 3rd-round pick from Anaheim Ducks for forwards Adam Henrique, Joseph Blandisi, 2018 3rd-round pick | Vatanen traded to Devils by Ducks for Henrique, Blandisi

 

NOVEMBER 30: New York Rangers acquire forward Peter Holland from Montreal Canadiens for forward Adam Cracknell | Cracknell traded to Canadiens by Rangers for Holland

 

NOVEMBER 23: Los Angeles Kings acquire forward Torrey Mitchell from Montreal Canadiens for a 2018 conditional pick | Mitchell traded to Kings by Canadiens for conditional 2018 pick

 

NOVEMBER 14: Edmonton Oilers acquire forward Michael Cammalleri from Los Angeles Kings for forward Jussi Jokinen | Cammalleri traded to Oilers by Kings for Jokinen

 

NOVEMBER 14: Tampa Bay Lightning acquire goaltender Louis Domingue from Arizona Coyotes for goaltender Michael Leighton and forward Tye McGinn | Lightning acquire goaltender Louis Domingue from Arizona

 

NOVEMBER 10: Florida Panthers acquire defenseman Ludwig Bystrom from Dallas Stars for defenseman Reece Scarlett | Panthers acquire defenseman Ludwig Bystrom from Dallas Stars

 

NOVEMBER 5: Ottawa Senators acquire forward Matt Duchene; Nashville Predators acquire Kyle Turris; Colorado Avalanche acquire forwards Shane Bowers and Vladislav Kamenev , goaltender Andrew Hammond , defenseman Samuel Girard, 2018 first-round pick, 2018 second-round pick and a 2019 third-round pick | Duchene sent to Ottawa as part of three-team trade

 

OCTOBER 28: Arizona Coyotes acquire goaltender Scott Wedgewood from the New Jersey Devils for a fifth round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft.

 

OCTOBER 21: Pittsburgh Penguins acquire forward Riley Sheahan and a fifth round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft from the Detroit Red Wings for Scott Wilson and a third round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft | Sheahan traded to Penguins by Red Wings

 

OCTOBER 21: New York Rangers acquire defenseman Ryan Sproul from the Detroit Red Wings for forward Matt Puempel.

 

OCTOBER 9: Philadelphia Flyers acquire goalie Dustin Tokarski from the Anaheim Ducks for future considerations.

 

OCTOBER 6: Toronto Maple Leafs acquire goalie Calvin Pickard from the Vegas Golden Knights for forward Tobias Lindberg and a sixth-round pick in the 2018 NHL Draft | Maple Leafs acquire Pickard from Golden Knights

 

OCTOBER 4: Chicago Blackhawks acquire forward Andreas Martinsen from the Montreal Canadiens for forward Kyle Baun | Blackhawks acquire Martinsen from Montreal

 

OCTOBER 4: Buffalo Sabres acquire defenseman Zach Redmond from the Montreal Canadiens for forward Nicholas Deslauriers | Sabres acquire Redmond from Montreal

 

OCTOBER 3: Vancouver Canucks acquire defenseman Derrick Pouliot from the Pittsburgh Penguins for defenseman Andrey Pedan, 2018 fourth-round pick | Penguins trade Pouliot to Canucks

 

SEPTEMBER 17: Arizona Coyotes acquire defenseman Jason Demers from the Florida Panthers for forward Jamie McGinn | Panthers trade Demers to Coyotes for McGinn

 

JULY 4: Carolina Hurricanes acquire forward Marcus Kruger from Vegas Golden Knights for 2018 fifth-round pick | Marcus Kruger traded to Hurricanes by Golden Knights 

 

JULY 2: New Jersey Devils acquire forward Marcus Johansson from Washington Capitals for 2018 second-round pick and 2018 third-round pick | Marcus Johansson traded to Devils from Capitals

 

JULY 2: Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward Marcus Kruger from Chicago Blackhawks for future considerations | Marcus Kruger traded to Golden Knights by Blackhawks

 

JULY 1: Nashville Predators acquire defenseman Alexei Emelin from Vegas Golden Knights for 2019 third-round pick | Alexei Emelin traded to Predators by Golden Knights

 

JULY 1: Detroit Red Wings acquire goaltender Tom McCollum from Calgary Flames for 2018 conditional seventh-round pick

 

JULY 1: Colorado Avalanche acquire forward Colin Wilson from the Nashville Predators for 2019 fourth-round pick | Colin Wilson traded by Predators to Avalanche

 

JULY 1: Tampa Bay Lightning acquire forward Carter Verhaeghe from the New York Islanders for the rights to goaltender Kristers Gudlevskis | Lightning acquire forward Carter Verhaeghe from Islanders

 

JUNE 30: Buffalo Sabres acquire forward Jason Pominville, defenseman Marco Scandella and 2018 fourth-round pick from the Minnesota Wild for forwards Tyler Ennis, Marcus Foligno and 2018 third-round pick | Marco Scandella, Jason Pominville traded by Wild to Sabres

 

JUNE 29: Calgary Flames acquire goalie Eddie Lack, defenseman Ryan Murphy and a 2019 seventh-round pick from the Carolina Hurricanes for defenseman Keegan Kanzig and a 2019 sixth-round pick | Eddie Lack traded to Flames by Hurricanes 

 

JUNE 26: Dallas Stars acquire defenseman Marc Methot from the Vegas Golden Knights for goalie Dylan Ferguson and a 2020 second-round pick | Marc Methot traded to Stars from Golden Knights

 

JUNE 24: San Jose Sharks acquire a 2017 sixth-round pick (No. 185) from the New Jersey Devils for two 2017 seventh-round picks (Nos. 205, 214).

 

JUNE 24: Montreal Canadiens acquire a 2017 seventh-round pick (No. 199) from the Philadelphia Flyers for a 2018 seventh-round pick.

 

JUNE 24: New York Islanders acquire a 2017 sixth-round pick (No. 165) from the Los Angeles Kings for a 2018 sixth-round pick.

 

JUNE 24: Chicago Blackhawks acquire a 2017 fourth-round pick (No. 112) from the Vancouver Canucks for a 2017 fifth-round pick (No. 135) and a 2017 sixth-round pick (No. 181).

 

JUNE 24: San Jose Sharks acquire a 2017 fourth-round pick (No. 102) from the New York Rangers for a 2017 fourth-round pick (No. 123) and a 2017 sixth-round pick (No. 174).

 

JUNE 24: Calgary Flames acquire defenseman Travis Hamonic and a conditional fourth-round pick from the New York Islanders for a 2018 first-round pick, a 2018 second-round pick and a conditional second-round pick. |  Hamonic traded to Flames by Islanders

 

JUNE 24: Edmonton Oilers acquire a 2017 third-round pick (No. 78) from the Arizona Coyotes for a 2017 third-round pick (No. 82) and a 2017 fifth-round pick (No. 126).

 

JUNE 24: Columbus Blue Jackets acquire a 2017 second-round pick (No. 45) from the Vegas Golden Knights for forward Keegan Kolesar.

 

JUNE 24: Philadelphia Flyers acquire a 2017 second-round pick (No. 35) from the Arizona Coyotes for a 2017 second-round pick (No. 44), a 2017 third-round pick (No. 75) and a 2017 fourth-round pick (No. 108).

 

JUNE 23: Pittsburgh Penguins acquire forward Ryan Reaves and a 2017 second-round pick (No. 51) from the St. Louis Blues for forward Oskar Sundqvist and a 2017 first-round pick (No. 31) | Reaves traded to Penguins by Blues

 

JUNE 23: St. Louis Blues acquire forward Brayden Schenn from the Philadelphia Flyers for forward Jori Lehtera, a 2017 first-round pick (No. 27) and a conditional 2018 first-round pick | Schenn traded to Blues by Flyers for Lehtera, picks

 

JUNE 23: Chicago Blackhawks acquire a 2017 first-round pick (No. 29) and a 2017 third-round pick (No. 70) from the Dallas Stars for a 2017 first-round pick (No. 26).

 

JUNE 23: Columbus Blue Jackets acquire Jordan Schroeder from the Minnesota Wild in exchange for Dante Salituro | Wild acquire Salituro from Blue Jackets

 

JUNE 23: Rangers acquire Anthony DeAngelo and the 2017 first-round pick (No. 7) from the Coyotes in exchange for Derek Stepan and Antti Raanta | Coyotes acquire Stepan and Raanta from Rangers  | Fantasy spin

 

JUNE 23: Blue Jackets acquire Artemi Panarin, Tyler Motte and a 2017 sixth-round draft pick from the Blackhawks in exchange for Brandon Saad, Anton Forsberg and 2018 fifth-round draft pick | Blue Jackets acquire Panarin from Blackhawks for Saad | Fantasy impact

 

JUNE 23: Arizona Coyotes acquire defenseman Niklas Hjalmarsson from the Chicago Blackhawks in exchange for defenseman Connor Murphy and forward Laurent Dauphin | Coyotes acquire defenseman Hjalmarsson from Blackhawks

 

JUNE 22: Montreal Canadiens acquire defenseman David Schlemko from the Vegas Golden Knights in exchange for a 2019 fifth-round pick | Canadiens acquire defenseman Schlemko from Vegas

 

JUNE 22: New York Islanders acquire forward Jordan Eberle from Edmonton Oilers in exchange for forward Ryan Strome | Eberle traded to Islanders by Oilers for Strome | Fantasy spin

 

JUNE 22: Carolina Hurricanes acquire defenseman Trevor van Riemsdyk and a 2018 seventh-round pick from the Vegas Golden Knights for a 2017 second-round pick | Van Riemsdyk acquired by Hurricanes from Golden Knights

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire a 2020 second-round pick from the Pittsburgh Penguins for future considerations.

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire a 2017 first-round pick and a 2019 third-round pick from the Winnipeg Jets for the Columbus Blues Jackets' 2017 first-round pick previously acquired by Vegas.

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward David Clarkson, a 2017 first-round pick and a 2019 second-round pick from the Columbus Blue Jackets for future considerations.

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward Alex Tuch from the Minnesota Wild for a third-round pick in either 2017 or 2018.

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire defenseman Shea Theodore from the Anaheim Ducks for future considerations.

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward Mikhail Grabovski, defenseman Jake Bischoff, a 2017 first-round pick and a 2019 second-round pick from the New York Islanders for future considerations. 

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward Nikita Gusev, a 2017 second-round pick and a 2018 fourth-round pick from the Tampa Bay Lightning for future considerations. 

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire a 2017 fifth-round pick from the Carolina Hurricanes previously acquired from the Boston Bruins for future considerations.

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire forward Reilly Smith from the Florida Panthers for a 2018 fourth-round pick.

 

JUNE 21: Vegas Golden Knights acquire a 2017 sixth-round pick in a trade with the Buffalo Sabres for future considerations.

 

JUNE 17: New Jersey Devils acquire defenseman Mirco Mueller and a 2017 fifth-round pick in a trade with the San Jose Sharks for a second-round and fourth-round pick in 2017 | Devils acquire D Mirco Mueller and pick No. 143 from San Jose

 

JUNE 17: Calgary Flames acquire Mike Smith in a trade with the Arizona Coyotes for Chad Johnson, defenseman prospect Brandon Hickey, and a conditional third-round pick | Smith acquired by Flames from Coyotes

 

JUNE 17: Buffalo Sabres acquire Nathan Beaulieu in a trade with the Montreal Canadiens for a third-round pick in the 2017 NHL Draft | Beaulieu acquired by Sabres from Canadiens

 

JUNE 15: Montreal Canadiens acquire Jonathan Drouin and a conditional sixth-round pick in 2018 draft in a trade with the Tampa Bay Lightning for defenseman prospect Mikhail Sergachev and a conditional second-round pick in the 2018 draft | Drouin traded to Canadiens by Lightning for Sergachev
